answer: An identity enters through a 12-round apprenticeship: each round assigns a fresh, randomly selected job, and three established peers must sign its output. A forge of aliases cannot reuse work because every proof commits to the account and round. The kth account from one funding kernel must complete 12k jobs, so 100 fakes require 60,600 verified jobs. Auditors replay commitments and peer signatures; any duplicate proof cuts every linked vine from rewards for 24 rounds.
